package rulefixtures

import (
	"io"
	"os"
)

// scenario for bufio_reader_missing_for_small_read_loop: File or socket reads inside loops without visible bufio buffering.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

func scenario343Positive(f *os.File) ([]byte, error) {
	var out []byte
	buf := make([]byte, 4096)
	for {
		n, err := f.Read(buf)
		if n > 0 {
			out = append(out, buf[:n]...)
		}
		if err != nil {
			if err == io.EOF {
				break
			}
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
